May 14, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Green Square Capital Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 3.57% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Green Square Capital Llc sold 3,443 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 93,134 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.76 million, down from 96,577 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Green Square Capital Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $926.95 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.38% or $0.72 during the last trading session, reaching $188.59. About 26.21 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 14, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Philippe Jabre increased its stake in Amazon Com Inc (AMZN) by 44.44% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jabre Capital Partners Sa bought 2,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 28.13% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Philippe Jabre held 6,500 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.60 million, up from 4,500 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jabre Capital Partners Sa who had been investing in Amazon Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $777.78B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.38% or $6.17 during the last trading session, reaching $1602.91. About 1.96M shares traded. Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) has risen 76.78% since May 14, 2017 and is uptrending.
